author: MarioNawfal
text:
🇸🇦 Saudi just pushed out a nationwide emergency warning guide... are they preparing for a full-blown war?

The graphic tells people EXACTLY what to do if they get an alert from the National Early Warning Platform.

MBS met with CENTCOM chief Adm. Brad Cooper yesterday...

The message is clear: the system is active and authorities want the public ready...

Source: Saudi Civil Defense / Writer: Samuel
